info.title: PlaneMem single reviewed audit view export
info.description: Source-only existing POST contract, TODO P0-01. Load audit-export/session-activity-read schemas and session-reads/search/context-history HTTP components locally. Complete bounded view/release result; no validator/generator/runtime/release evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure deployment origin/base.

x-runtime-boundaries.http: Signed context and verified client before reading body. Reject URL query, non-JSON media type, content-encoding and listed cache/range/write headers. Accepted Content-Type regex is application/json optionally ;charset=utf-8 (case-insensitive, unquoted); not arbitrary JSON suffix. JSON object raw read<=4096 bytes with nonfatal UTF8; invalid/empty/nonobject/oversized body=>INVALID_INPUT400, not413. Handler also limits JSON.stringify input4096. Connection close and selected x-trace-id set before authentication. Optional expected actor/client headers each bind signed claims; no top-level identity override in closed selection.
x-runtime-boundaries.authorization: Entry policy audit.read plus decision audit/generic rate limit. Handler independently requires authenticated_client=true, actual audit.read and at least one actual data.export/data.restricted.export, finite unexpired token time; admin cannot replace these. Selected scope exactly equals verified scope. For each read, canRead/canExport plus local PolicyService and configured OPA export.audit must allow. Restricted requires data.restricted.read and data.restricted.export; public still needs initial actual export capability. Captured authority rechecked for expiry/deadline after async steps, no token refresh/revocation polling.
x-runtime-boundaries.selection: Scope nonempty<=256 UTF16/no controls/DEL/lone surrogates, target ULID, lowercase64 SHA256 without prefix. Full reviewed document is not sent to Gateway, only original selection. Caller review is not proven by this wire request. No keys/version/CAS or automatic replacement with latest content.
x-runtime-boundaries.read: WorkbenchRepository.listAudit exact audit_id, scoped audit rows and restricted filter; no separate current project visibility/deletion join. Shared envelope validates scope/current trace/sole postgres source/unique exact target and complete bounded record; empty result404. SQL clips details>32KiB to null and sources>16KiB to[], preserving original JSONB text byte counts; oversized16KiB metadata or malformed rows fail. Parser strips record/source extensions, normalizes microsecond time, requires candidate record<=68KiB plus independent field budgets. session_id is nullable/nonempty text, not independently ULID validated. Source contents not recursively reauthorized.
x-runtime-boundaries.prepare: First read and classification authorization, canonical bounded document and actual Node SHA256 must equal selection. Second independent read must produce identical canonical document then classification authorization repeats. No transaction-wide locked snapshot; hidden omitted content changes with identical visible projection are not detected. Final-read or policy changes after checks are outside the promise. Existing classification redaction is retained; no raw details retrieval.
x-runtime-boundaries.canonical: Normalize scope/record then recursively sort JS object keys and JSON.stringify preserving arrays; finite JSON, integer numbers safe, plain/null-prototype objects,<=10000 nodes/depth64/canonical UTF8 document96KiB. Not a claim of standards-compatible JCS. SHA256/bytes cover canonical document only, not whole envelope/download file; digest is not signature or authenticity proof.
x-runtime-boundaries.release: Require durable sink before work. Successful classification checks and unchanged reviewed view lead to audit.export.release persistence before content return; sink ID ULID and different from target. Classification refusal writes audit.export.denied with0 bytes then denies; sink failure takes precedence. General entry decision audit is separate. Configured callback writes target classification/source,row_count1,bounded_view,document bytes/hash,omission flags,delivery_confirmed=false under a fresh key; normal redaction replaces nonpublic digest string. Post-persistence observer failure ignored. No receipt lookup/retry deduplication/delivery confirmation; every successful explicit request can create another release.
x-runtime-boundaries.capacity-deadline: At most2 admitted handler work items per registration,60s deadline from handler entry. Excludes prior auth/body/entry Policy/audit and later HTTP send. Promise race stops waiting but does not abort SQL/OPA/audit sink; slot remains held until work actually settles. assertActive prevents late successful return. Deadline can expire during sink: response may be unconfirmed even if release later persists. Known release recorded before timeout/validation failure appears in handler failure details; underlying ContractErrors may have other details.
x-runtime-boundaries.response: Complete normalized envelope<=128KiB, current trace, two ordered audit sources target then release, no ETag. parseAuditExportEnvelope checks original scope/ID/declared hash/canonical bytes/release inequality/states; it does not compute digest. audit_state=release-recorded with client_delivery_state=not-confirmed is not HTTP delivery or file-save proof. Generic idempotency cache bypassed; no original response reuse. Server error response has no dedicated16KiB serialization cap.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: WcpClient.exportAuditView(reviewedDocument,{timeout_ms?,signal?}) snapshots context and canonicalizes/clones reviewed document synchronously before waiting; configured context is validated by WcpClient (including ULID scope). Reject inherited idempotency_key/expected_version/if_match. Exact reviewed scope; WebCrypto SHA256 before send, full response parse/clone, canonical equality and recomputed hash before returning in-memory envelope. No replacement read, file save or automatic retry. Option timeout integer1..2147483647, default90000ms includes hashing and custom transport; synchronous work only checked after completion.
x-runtime-boundaries.transport: SDK requests bounded-json success128KiB; Fetch transport error16KiB, strict UTF8/media/JSON, success exact200 and exact trace header; any supplied error trace header and parsed error trace must match. 401 handled before body parsing. Optional content-length canonical safe digits, checked against decoded bytes only absent/identity encoding; compressed response still decoded-byte bounded. Redirect:error/no-store. Separate Fetch default30s includes credentials/network/body and races SDK90s; slower layer does not extend earlier deadline. Custom transport whole local wait bounded but cannot be forced to stop external work.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk-errors: Known same-trace error codes mapped to finite local messages, others GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE; original messages/details not exposed. After target known, preserves trusted valid distinct release ID from same-trace error or already parsed result, otherwise unconfirmed; always client_delivery_state not-confirmed and retryable=false. Unknown/late network outcomes do not prove rollback. No automatic recovery query.
x-runtime-boundaries.mock: Existing MockAuditStore/MockWcpServer supports this path with explicit export_access and isolated in-memory release records; it is not durable release evidence, live Policy/OPA or mutable double-read race simulation. No SDK/Mock machine-schema integration added here.

post.summary: Prepare exactly one reviewed bounded audit view after durable release audit
post.description: Reject URL query and write/cache/range conditions. Actual export capabilities, two exact reads/classification authorizations, unchanged canonical reviewed digest and durable release required. Historical omitted content stays omitted; success does not confirm client delivery.

Success.description: Full bounded-view document with canonical document digest/length and confirmed release ID, ordered audit sources and not-confirmed client delivery. No ETag. Entire JSON<=128KiB.

connection.description: Built-in Node HTTP response closes connection; intermediaries can alter hop-by-hop headers.

Error.description: Application error; handler fail errors include AuditExportFailureState, but outer auth/body/audit or propagated database errors may not. Known release does not imply delivery; unconfirmed does not prove no persistent release. No server error byte guarantee.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT400 false for non-JSON media/query/prohibited conditions, invalid/empty/nonobject/oversized4KiB body or closed selection/key/version/handler JSON size. Body is read after verified authentication. Oversize is400, not413.

Unauthenticated.description: UNAUTHENTICATED401 false for signed token/client boundary; unavailable verifier may503. No raw-header compatibility fallback.

Denied.description: DENIED403 false for scope/expected identity/entry Policy or missing actual audit/export capabilities, invalid/expired session or classification/OPA refusal. Record-level refusal persists denied audit first; persistence failure instead503. OPA unavailable is policy denial.

NotFound.description: NOT_FOUND404 false for empty exact selected audit view in scoped/restricted-filtered read; not a replacement latest record. A restricted record filtered before read has no record-specific denied audit.

Conflict.description: AUDIT_EXPORT_CONFLICT409 false for original reviewed digest mismatch or changed canonical document between reads. Preserve original selection; reread/review explicitly, no automatic replacement.

InvalidStored.description: WORKBENCH_AUDIT_INVALID500 false for malformed/oversized bounded view, canonical complexity or non-contract work failure, including final envelope validation. Handler-created errors preserve known release state; repository ContractErrors retain original details. Uncaught outer INTERNAL_ERROR can500 true.

Unavailable.description: AUDIT_EXPORT_BUSY and AUDIT_EXPORT_TIMEOUT503 false, no Retry-After guarantee and no408 mapping. Handler missing/unconfirmed release sink AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 false; generic entry audit same code503 true. WORKBENCH_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE503 true; auth availability503 true. Timeout retains capacity until work settles and may race a committed release.
